svg.title: astop monitoring eight Ascend 910B4-1 NPUs
svg.desc: Terminal preview rendered from a live astop -P session. Eight NPU cards show utilization, HBM use, temperature, power, PCIe generation and traffic, ECC errors, and HCCS health and traffic, followed by eight live history graphs. The process list is hidden.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, monospace
